items.title: Laurence Juber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: That goes back to — I mean that goes back to Wilfred Mellers, and in the mid-60s he wrote a book called Twilight of the Gods which was a very intense musicological analysis of Beatles songwriting.

ctx.x: And we were in the Beatles shop and there was this scholarly looking book and I opened it up and it was about the Beatles songwriting and I landed on this sentence and it was talking about the use of the Locrian scale. And I thought wow.
That goes back to — I mean that goes back to Wilfred Mellers, and in the mid-60s he wrote a book called Twilight of the Gods which was a very intense musicological analysis of Beatles songwriting.
Do you agree with the concept of analyzing their work from a classical theoretical sense like that?
